excavation_context.character_description: Adult male grad student museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin, wearing a light blue tee shirt under a crisp white lab coat, blue jean slacks, and black dress shoes. Wears signature thin-rimmed black rectangular lens glasses.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1 is utilizing an optical magnifier at his lab table to inspect a flaky, carbonized chunk of dark woody brown lignite matrix. Trapped in the dark organic wood layers surrounding the fossil is a razor-sharp Albertosaurus tooth. Focused overhead workbench illumination catching the gold reflections in his black rectangular glasses. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
